title: I Compared 3 AI Receptionists for Small Business (2026)
hook: Missed calls cost a small business real money. Here is what AI receptionists can and cannot do in 2026.

sections.heading: Missed calls cost you money
bullets: But not every tool is worth it
sections.narration: Missed calls cost a small business real money. Most callers who hit voicemail simply hang up and call the next company. In this sample section we test the pipeline, not real tools.

sections.heading: What an AI receptionist does
sections.narration: An AI receptionist answers the phone, asks a few qualifying questions, books an appointment into your calendar and texts you a summary. That is the promise. Let's see what it costs.

sections.heading: The simple cost math
bullets: Price per month vs per minute
sections.narration: Here is the simple math. If one extra booking a month pays for the tool, it is worth testing. If your calls are mostly existing customers, it probably is not.

sections.heading: Verdict
sections.narration: My verdict. Service businesses that live on the phone should test one. If you get three calls a week, skip it. Tell me in the comments what your business does, and subscribe for more honest AI tool breakdowns.
